name: cas-p2p-chat
description: End-to-end encrypted peer-to-peer desktop chat over WebRTC (Electron, Vue, Vuetify, Tailwind) with an Express + PostgreSQL server for signaling and find-by-name, built on cas-typescript-sdk.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @cas-p2p-chat/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @cas-p2p-chat/desktop --
